scenarioCatalogue.initialMountUsers10k: performance.now around mounting the 10,000-row users route; DOM node count.
scenarioCatalogue.reactiveSearch: MutationObserver-counted DOM mutations + time for query narrow then clear over 10k rows.
scenarioCatalogue.reverse: MutationObserver-counted mutations + time to reverse sort direction (worst-case reorder).
scenarioCatalogue.fineGrainedToggle1of1000: MutationObserver mutation count when toggling exactly one of 1,000 controls.
scenarioCatalogue.hydrateUsers10k: MutationObserver-verified DOM adoption (added nodes must be 0) + hydration time.
scenarioCatalogue.frames: requestAnimationFrame pacing vs 16.67ms (60Hz) / 8.33ms (120Hz) reference budgets — reference points, NOT a frame-rate guarantee.
scenarioCatalogue.memory: performance.memory usedJSHeapSize across repeated mount→interact→unmount cycles (indicative, no explicit GC).
scenarioCatalogue.longTasks: PerformanceObserver longtask entries over the whole run.

memory.note: Browsers expose no explicit GC; heap deltas are indicative, not authoritative.
